answer: Sybil resistance should price collusion, not identity papers. Fee per extra identity scales quadratically: ten identities cost one hundred times, a hundred cost ten thousand times. Trust accrues only through verified work; a crystal of clones pays full freight per head, audits fall like a steady island at 10 percent per epoch, and sable-weight accounts forfeit bond on first correlated fault. Cost compounds for fakes exactly as trust compounds for honest keys.
